integrity: Proof is algebraic and self-contained. Supplemental exact-symbolic and numerical verifier included. Earlier generic adjoint composition may partially cover the deterministic structure. Priority remains subject to independent investigation.
scientific_limitations: Scalar constant-coefficient linear test equation; stability asserted at completed two-step blocks, not individual steps or general nonlinear/nonautonomous problems. Correlating stage fractions changes the independence assumptions used in existing global error bounds.
title: Antithetic stage pairing restores pathwise A-stability to randomized implicit Runge–Kutta updates
